story: An icon of the skies, the Chestnut Headed Tesia (Cettia castaneocoronata) is a species from the Cettiidae family. It thrives in Montane and hill forests; densely vegetated wet/damp areas near streams and gullies, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Chestnut Headed Tesia is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Chestnut Headed Tesia helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Chestnut Headed Tesia, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
